Due to the weight of this item, it will require assistance with unloading & moving at point of delivery.

This 4lite Advantage single 4ft LED IP20 batten light is a slimline, polycarbonate lighting solution for various indoor applications. Ideal for workshops, garages, and commercial or industrial settings, it delivers powerful illumination. The integrated LED technology provides 4900 lumens of bright light with a 36W power consumption. Users can select between warm, cool, or daylight white colour temperatures (3000/4000/6500K) to suit different environments. Designed for reliable performance, it features a robust polycarbonate body and metal clips for straightforward ceiling installation.
b: Suitable for Both Domestic & Commercial Use
